name: I Left My A-Rank Party to Help My Former Students Reach the Dungeon Depths!
description: Not every party treats you like a hero—especially when you’re a lowly red mage like Yuke. So, after years of constant ridicule by his A-rank party members, he ditches them. Searching for a new party, he reunites with former students Marina, Silk, and Rain, and joins their group. But on a quest to conquer the world’s greatest dungeon, they become entangled in chaos that threatens the world.

videos.title: Special Party Feature: Clover!
videos.overview: A special edition highlighting the up-and-coming party that everyone's talking about: Clover!

videos.title: Clover Is Born
videos.overview: Yuke, a red mage, quits his A-rank party, Thunder Pike, because he feels they don't appreciate the support he provides. While seeking a new party, he encounters one of his former students, Marina, who invites him to join her new D-rank party.

videos.title: The Forest Where a Magic Beast Dwells
videos.overview: Clover's first stream has drawn a lot of attention, so they accept another quest in a forest that's been taken over by a magic beast.

videos.title: Overflow
videos.overview: Clover's success in slaying the Zarnag draws more attention to them—and draws Thunder Pike's attention back to Yuke.

videos.title: Shadow Stalker
videos.overview: Clover accepts a quest to help promote an armor workshop's latest line of adventuring gear.

videos.title: Mission
videos.overview: Clover goes house-hunting, and Simon tries to bring Yuke back by offering to grant his lifelong dream.

videos.title: Achromatic Darkness
videos.overview: Clover begins its investigation of Achromatic Darkness... and already trouble is brewing.

videos.title: The Pale, Immortal Ruler
videos.overview: Continuing the investigation of Achromatic Darkness, Clover reaches a floor of the dungeon that has... a sky?

videos.title: One Who Was Once a Friend
videos.overview: Yuke decides to head back into Achromatic Darkness to save Jamie, but Simon stands in the way.

videos.title: A Six-Leaf Clover
videos.overview: Shortly after Nene and Jamie officially join Clover, the party learns about a newly discovered dungeon.

videos.title: Clover's Back in Action!
videos.overview: Clover travels to a newly discovered dungeon to undertake their first quest since returning to adventuring.

videos.title: The Capital Distorted by the Twilight
videos.overview: Clover takes their first dive into the new dungeon near Duna, and everything they encounter feels off somehow.

videos.title: The Golden Priestess
videos.overview: As scholars assess Clover's findings from the new dungeon, the unconscious girl they found inside wakes up.

videos.title: Biblion, the Book Spirit
videos.overview: Clover returns to Glad Shi-im with three other parties in hopes of uncovering the truth of the twilight city.

videos.title: One Gold
videos.overview: Clover returns to Glad Shi-im to infiltrate Vordan Castle and destroy the One Gold that threatens the world.

videos.title: Crossing Time
videos.overview: Clover must battle the monsters of Glad Shi-im and even their own allies to find and destroy the One Gold.

videos.title: Return From the Twilight, And...
videos.overview: When Yuke returns from Glad Shi-im, he learns that Rain has gone to see Mastoma, the Salmutarian prince.

videos.title: The Seven-Leaf Clover
videos.overview: Clover returns to Finis with Niberune, who has officially become their seventh party member.

videos.title: King's Order
videos.overview: A long-sealed dungeon in Salmutaria is reawakening, and King Vincent wants Yuke to go there and check it out.

videos.title: The Dungeon Count of Welmelia
videos.overview: Clover begins their adventure in Salmutaria by inspecting the path to the dungeon that has reawakened there.

videos.title: The World Turns Inside-Out
videos.overview: Clover's inspection of the dungeon in Salmutaria suddenly takes a frightening turn.

videos.title: Tenebre
videos.overview: Prince Rafuma's reckless assault on Tenebre yields further insight into its truly terrifying nature.

videos.title: An Unexpected Reunion
videos.overview: Clover finally enters Tenebre, fully expecting the unexpected... and still, what they find inside shocks them.

videos.title: The End of the Darkness
videos.overview: Clover heads into the depths of Achromatic Darkness to find its Abyss Gate.

videos.title: Beyond the Dream
videos.overview: Clover reaches the Abyss Gate in the depths of Achromatic Darkness, but can they succeed in closing it?
